environment: local candidate commit 15d56f0e5812a06e03dea781487f7553ce010a5c; no deployed URL
applicability_reason: The application has a versioned JavaScript dependency graph that must be evaluated before a release claim.
expected: A compatible dependency and reachability scan completes on the frozen lockfile and build, triages material findings and records reproducible evidence.
observed: The pre-remediation production graph first reported 14 advisories (7 HIGH and 7 MODERATE). Moving the runtime to Next 16.2.11 reduced the result to 5 transitive advisories; workspace overrides then pinned sharp 0.35.0 and postcss 8.5.26. On candidate commit 15d56f0e5812a06e03dea781487f7553ce010a5c, the durable `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=moderate` log records exit 0 and `No known vulnerabilities found`; the durable release-verification log records lint/typecheck success, 144/144 tests, a completed build, a valid 95/100 local scorecard, a deterministic CycloneDX-structured lockfile inventory, a passing build artifact validator and the exact holding smoke. The CycloneDX inventory was not validated against the official schema and is not VEX, provenance or reachability. Passive source review reports 0 CRITICAL, 0 HIGH and 0 MEDIUM findings and tracks 6 conditional LOW observations: 2 mitigated in the local scope and 4 partially mitigated. The separate integrated Codex Security scan still FAILED while reading a nested sourcemap and produced no durable scan identifier or reachability conclusion.
method: Retest of the production dependency graph with pnpm audit, deterministic lockfile inventory generation, build artifact validation and passive manual source review of local publication, persistence, cooperative local-filesystem locking, media, backup and workbench boundaries. Final outputs are retained under evidence/95-local-technical-checkpoint and bound by a SHA-256 manifest to candidate commit 15d56f0e5812a06e03dea781487f7553ce010a5c. The historical evidence/87-local-checkpoint capture is preserved separately. The failed integrated reachability scan is recorded as FAILED/NOT_TESTED and was not treated as executed.
preconditions: The package manifest, workspace override policy and lockfile identify the audited production graph.
Final local release verification passes with 144/144 tests and a production build.
limitations: The final package audit is an advisory-database result at execution time; it is not a pentest, exploitability or full reachability conclusion.
A durable CycloneDX-structured lockfile inventory is retained, but official-schema validation, VEX, provenance attestation and durable integrated reachability remain absent.
The integrated Codex Security scan failed on a nested sourcemap and remains NOT_TESTED as a technique.
The source review was passive: no exploit, fuzz, active scan or deployed-runtime test was performed. Cooperative local lock contention was exercised, but hostile or distributed locking was not.
impact: Known production advisories were removed from the final audited graph, but a vulnerable reachable component or code-level weakness outside the advisory database could still remain undetected.
prevalence: The complete production dependency graph and generated bundles.
false_positive_analysis: The zero-advisory result is scoped to the production dependency audit at execution time. It does not justify a zero-risk or zero-vulnerability claim and does not suppress the failed reachability technique.
counterevidence: The retained production-audit log for candidate commit 15d56f0e5812a06e03dea781487f7553ce010a5c exited 0 with no known vulnerabilities after the recorded upgrade and overrides.
The retained release-verification log for the same candidate records lint/typecheck success, 144/144 passing tests, a completed production build and the local release gates.

Passive review and focused tests confirmed loopback-only administration, bearer and exact-origin checks, payload limits, fail-closed publication, escaped rendering, cooperative local lock contention and backup integrity checks.
remediation_minimum: Keep the production audit at zero known advisories on the frozen candidate and retain its raw output; validate the CycloneDX inventory against the official schema if it will be represented as an interoperable SBOM, and complete compatible reachability or VEX/provenance evidence before public release. Keep the integrated scanner marked FAILED/NOT_TESTED until a real compatible run completes.
additional_hardening: Automate recurring dependency review and expiry-bound exceptions; preserve cooperative local lock tests and fail-closed stale-lock handling, strengthen handle-relative reparse-point/TOCTOU controls, projection at every adapter boundary, uniform rejection of local-only media URLs and local-token throttling/rotation before any architecture broadens beyond trusted loopback use. Use a transactional or distributed datastore/lock design for production rather than extending the local filesystem protocol.
effort: Low to medium for retained audit evidence and hardening; scanner compatibility may vary
retest: Repeat the production audit and artifact inventory on every changed frozen commit/build; validate the CycloneDX document against the official schema if used interoperably, then complete a compatible reachability or VEX/provenance review. Reverify the four partially mitigated LOW observations and the two locally mitigated controls without promoting passive evidence to a pentest.
residual_risk: The production graph had no known advisories at the recorded audit and a structured lockfile inventory plus artifact report are retained, but official SBOM-schema conformance, reachability, provenance, dynamic exploitation and deployed-runtime security remain untested. The integrated scanner remains FAILED/NOT_TESTED. Public/legal release remains NO-GO.
